top_choice_rationale: P001 is a defined chemical reaction (amine binding, deprotonation, C-N reductive elimination) solved by ligand design, independently reproduced for about thirty years, with a clean two-name attribution (Buchwald, Hartwig) and a citation worded as the general catalytic method that protects against the Kosugi precursor and the 2010 overlap. P002 is scientifically worthy but its laureate allocation among Cullis, Hope, Madden, MacLachlan, Anderson and Langer is unsettled and it sits close to the 2023 Medicine prize, so it ranks second; no award ranks last because a mature, well-attributed discovery is available.
